Reason: SLP(Crl.) No.10565/2025 1
UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the  following  O R D E R 1.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the pleadings.
2. The petitioner has been convicted for the offences punishable under Sections 376(1) and 354(A)(1)(i) of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and was sentenced to undergo ten years imprisonment.
3. The petitioners appeal against the conviction is pending in the High Court.
The application of the petitioner seeking suspension of sentence has been rejected.

4. In the facts and circumstances of the case, coupled with the fact that the appeal is of the year,
2024 and it may not be possible to immediately hear the matter finally, we are of the view that the petitioner is entitled for suspension of sentence during the pendency of the appeal before the High Court.

5. Accordingly, the sentence awarded to the petitioner stands suspended during the pendency of the appeal before the High Court and he may be released on bail subject to the terms and conditions that may be imposed by the Trial Court commensurating with the charges, if any, framed against him.
In addition, the petitioner shall surrender his passport, if any, before the Trial Court itself.
6. The special leave petition stands disposed of in the above terms.
7. Pending application(s), if any, shall stand disposed of.
(SNEHA DAS) (NIDHI MATHUR)
